action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage of all legal moves at depth 3-4 to identify the best-evidenced candidates, then verify one.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search with no prior analyses, no commit-ready moves and replan not required. Board is an endgame up material (B+R+3P vs R). Rook cuts, king activity and pawn pushes matter; must not allow Black rook counterplay (Rxg4, Rxa3). Full root scan first, using analysis_nodes_available=3000 at depth 4.
